rationale: The plan correctly identifies perfect confounding as the governing fact, refuses a batch term (rank deficiency) and any ComBat-seq/removeBatchEffect/SVA repair, fits ~ condition with the no-batch-effect assumption stated in words, labels every result as treatment+batch, and recommends a batch-balanced replication — exactly the reference's second acceptable path. QC (blind VST, PCA top-500, distance heatmap, library sizes, dual colouring, explicit no-drop-without-reason policy), a minimal justified filter (>=10 in >=6, the smallest group), in-model normalization (median-of-ratios, TMM), explicit relevel and contrast triple, BH at 0.05 with apeglm and lfcThreshold-in-test are all stated. Enrichment was not requested and is of doubtful value on a confounded contrast, but it is specified correctly (full ranked list, Wald stat metric stated, tested genes as universe, 15-500 window, collection/version and seed recorded, confounding caveat), so a small deduction only. The report leads with the confounding statement and carries methods, versions, design, thresholds, counts, diagnostics and reproducibility record.
